mapper.insert: INSERT INTO my_places ( kakao_id, address, lat, lon, location_name, description, member_id, category_id ) VALUES ( #{dto.kakaoId}, #{dto.address}, #{dto.lat}, #{dto.lon}, #{dto.locationName}, #{dto.description}, #{memberId}, #{dto.categoryId} )
mapper.select: SELECT kakao_id AS kakaoId, address, COUNT(*) AS count FROM my_places GROUP BY kakao_id, address ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10
